notes: Systemic: many bodies are broad-scope boilerplate (no regulation text; wrong 'Regulated Area' copied, e.g. GB 11562 lighting text, GB 19578 emissions text, GB 17675/1589 empty headings) and AI summaries paraphrase that boilerplate generically. AI un_equivalent_ai often adds unrelated UN Rs (R125 for indirect vision/defrost, R127 for non-pedestrian items, R153/R16/R14 swaps). GB 14166/14167 grounded/AI equivalents are swapped. Chinese 客车 (bus) mistranslated as passenger vehicle in GB 13057. Several 2025/2026 editions not yet/just in force: 11562-2025 (2027-01-01), 17675-2025, 18384-2025, 20071-2025 (2026-07-01) need status/transition wording. Search budget was exhausted before checking GB 15086, 18352.6 dates.
